ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms fault scenarios, stop conditions and the unapproved-production flag are declared; it does not inject any fault.
offer: Choose faults that test a resilience assumption and define immediate stop conditions. Production chaos requires explicit approval and measured safeguards.

minimal.reason: List the faults that test a resilience assumption. Random breakage teaches nothing, so name each scenario and what it checks.

mid.reason: Define the conditions that stop the experiment immediately. Without them a fault can run away, so write the abort criteria.

maximal.reason: Set production experiments without approval to false. Production chaos needs explicit sign-off and safeguards, so obtain it first.
